summary: Expose a dashboard slot for first-run project and engine setup actions.
userImpact: A compatible Cloud plugin can guide new workspace administrators into the existing setup flows.
Cloud signup describes organization requests and explains that email sign-in works with a one-time link and offers optional passkey setup.

changes: Adds a dashboard frontend slot with permission-aware workspace setup actions.

security: Each setup action uses the current permission decision and the existing application workflow.
knownLimitations: The host requires a compatible frontend plugin to render the setup panel.
rollback: Restore the previous compatible host and plugin composition.
validation: Focused frontend workflow tests and type checks.
